related.title: 共軛焦顯微鏡
related.transfer: 可遷移「雙光子吸收與固有光學切片」與「功率、脈衝與點擴散函數校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；共軛焦顯微鏡的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Two-photon absorption and intrinsic optical sectioning" and "Power, pulse and point-spread calibration" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Confocal microscopy must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦I² 非線性激發、脈衝寬度與重複率、散射深度與色散預補償的工程預算；共軛焦顯微鏡則以針孔艾里單位、光學切片厚度、光子預算與雷射掃描系統的校正為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on engineering budgets for I² nonlinear excitation, pulse width and repetition rate, scattering depth and dispersion precompensation; Confocal microscopy centres on pinhole Airy units, optical-section thickness, photon budgets and calibration of laser-scanning systems, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「焦點處的 I² 激發體積」與「共軛焦針孔與艾里斑」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到共軛焦顯微鏡，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「折射率失配、球差與軸向誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “I² excitation volume at the focus” and “Confocal pinhole and Airy disc”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Confocal microscopy, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Index mismatch, spherical aberration and the axial error budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 光學頻率梳穩定系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「雙光子吸收與固有光學切片」與「功率、脈衝與點擴散函數校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；光學頻率梳穩定系統的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Two-photon absorption and intrinsic optical sectioning" and "Power, pulse and point-spread calibration" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Optical-frequency-comb stabilization systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦I² 非線性激發、脈衝寬度與重複率、散射深度與色散預補償的工程預算；光學頻率梳穩定系統則以f_n = n·f_rep + f_ceo、f-2f 自參考與雙迴路鎖相的梳狀雷射工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on engineering budgets for I² nonlinear excitation, pulse width and repetition rate, scattering depth and dispersion precompensation; Optical-frequency-comb stabilization systems centres on comb engineering around f_n = n·f_rep + f_ceo, f-2f self-referencing and dual-loop phase locking, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「焦點處的 I² 激發體積」與「梳齒方程式與載波包絡相位」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到光學頻率梳穩定系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「殘餘雜訊、週期滑脫與誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “I² excitation volume at the focus” and “Comb equation and carrier-envelope phase”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Optical-frequency-comb stabilization systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Residual noise, cycle slips and the error budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 雙光子顯微鏡
history.text: Maria Göppert-Mayer 在 1931 年的博士論文中預測雙光子吸收，但要等到 1990 年 Denk、Strickler 與 Webb 在康乃爾大學把飛秒染料雷射與雷射掃描顯微鏡結合，才首次示範雙光子螢光成像。1990 年代鈦藍寶石雷射的商品化讓技術普及，2000 年代起神經科學以雙光子在活體腦中記錄鈣訊號，Svoboda 等實驗室並公開模組化顯微鏡設計；2010 年代的 1300 與 1700 nm 長波長激發與三光子成像把深度推向 1 mm 以上。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Maria Göppert-Mayer predicted two-photon absorption in her 1931 doctoral thesis, but only in 1990 did Denk, Strickler and Webb at Cornell University combine a femtosecond dye laser with a laser-scanning microscope to demonstrate two-photon fluorescence imaging. Commercial Ti:sapphire lasers in the 1990s spread the technique, from the 2000s neuroscience used two-photon imaging to record calcium signals in living brains, and laboratories such as Svoboda's published modular microscope designs; in the 2010s long-wavelength excitation at 1300 and 1700 nm and three-photon imaging pushed depth beyond 1 mm. This course rebuilds only public principles and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「雙光子吸收與固有光學切片」到「系統驗證、散射假體與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Two-photon absorption and intrinsic optical sectioning" through "System validation, scattering phantom and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
